about: This is the first year the celebration is held at the newly renovated City Hall Plaza on East University Avenue.
The city lists nine performing groups, from an orchestra and a youth chorus to dance companies and a theatre troupe.
Mayor Harvey Ward joins the tree lighting, and Santa visits the same evening.
The Holiday Kids' Dance Party at nearby Bo Diddley Plaza runs earlier the same afternoon, on the same street.
faq: When is the Gainesville Holiday Lights Celebration?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at City Hall Plaza, 200 E. University Ave.
Does the Gainesville Holiday Lights Celebration cost anything?
No. The city lists the cost as free.
Who performs at the Holiday Lights Celebration?

The city lists the Annasemble Orchestra, Sun Country Dance Theatre, Gainesville Youth Chorus, 1000 Voices of Florida, Dance Alive National Ballet Next Generation, Star Center Theatre, Gainesville Harmony Chorus and The Singers of the Reformation.
Is Santa at the Gainesville celebration?
Yes. The city says Santa visits during the tree lighting, and it lists Santa and Grinch Villages.
What is new this year?
The city says the celebration is at the newly renovated City Hall Plaza for the first time.

kids: Dance to music from DJ E-LO
Grab a snack from a food truck
Stay for the evening lights celebration
table: City of Gainesville Parks, Recreation and Cultural Affairs
about: DJ E-LO runs the music for the party, which the city describes as a chance to dance, sing and celebrate the holidays.
Food trucks sell food on site, so lunch or a snack is covered.
The city's Holiday Lights Celebration starts at 5 pm the same day at City Hall Plaza, also on East University Avenue.
faq: When is the Gainesville Holiday Kids' Dance Party?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 1:30 to 3 pm at Bo Diddley Plaza, 111 E. University Ave.
Is the dance party free?
Yes. The city lists the cost as free, and food truck items are sold separately.
Who is the DJ?
The city lists DJ E-LO.
Is there food?
Yes. Food trucks sell food on site.
What else is happening that day?
The Holiday Lights Celebration is at City Hall Plaza from 5 to 8 pm.
